name: hf-disturbed-long-alarm-fresh-history
purpose: Prospective paired raw-bit acceptance characterization on a fresh current-history seed, 9601, previously used only in an older weak holdout. Both polarities use the same new 9601 source/noise history, omitted noise-seed override, C/N0 12 dB-Hz, requested 128-second bits, 4096-sample chunks, CPU/reference/RRC, Helper and FEC off, and the full automatic worker allocation. Each row sends five identical one-bit emissions at public slots 0, 3, 6, 9, and 12 through one continuous channel and receiver, with two scored quiet opportunities after each emission. This is a paired fixed-history characterization, not a probability estimate. Preserve valid misses. Before any receive run, plan-only validation must confirm its public key fingerprint matches the seed-9202 baseline.
